reasons.claim: The text is a saying on the merit of Mina's mosque with no transmitter written before it, so it has no chain of its own.
reasons.quote: وَ مَنْ صَلَّى فِي مَسْجِدِ مِنًى

reviews.uncertainty_note: The closing quotation mark suggests the end of a longer saying whose chain stands in an earlier report not given in the packet.

reasons.claim: The only name written before the saying is the Imam after «عن», the one who speaks, so he is the single link after the compiler.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters joined by «و» stand at one level before the Imam, giving two routes.
reasons.quote: رِبْعِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ وَ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The chain runs through three names to the Imam who tells the story.
reasons.quote: رَوَى عَاصِمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ

reasons.claim: The people in the story the Imam tells are not links of its chain.
The text is one sentence of a saying with no transmitter written in it.

reviews.uncertainty_note: It reads as the end of a longer saying whose chain may stand in an earlier report not given in the packet.

reasons.claim: The passive «روي» names no transmitter, so there is no chain.
The chain is a named narrator, an unnamed gap, then the Imam who speaks.
reasons.quote: اَلرَّيَّانُ بْنُ اَلصَّلْتِ عَمَّنْ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ

reasons.claim: The compiler's shaykh heard Abu Umar being asked; the epithet after his name is not part of the link.
reasons.quote: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عُمَرَ صاحِبَ أَبي العَبَّاسِ ثَعلَبٍ يُسْأَلُ

reasons.claim: Abu Umar is the one who answers, so he is the last link; the Prophet's words are only quoted in the question.

reviews.question: the Prophet speaking a one-sentence report with no transmitter

reasons.claim: No transmitter is written before the saying, so there is no route whichever way the question is ruled.
The chain opens with the compiler's father, named only by the kinship word.
«أخيه علي» is one link, and the chain runs in order to the Imam who speaks.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَخِيهِ عَلِيٍّ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ

reasons.claim: The last links are Maymun and the Imam.
reasons.quote: عَنْ مَيْمُونٍ الْبَانِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الصَّادِقِ
